candidates.change_summary: Change the require that enforces msg.sender equality to the hardcoded address into the opposite check, allowing all callers except that address.
Remove the existing require that enforces msg.sender equality so any caller can invoke transfer.
Change the multiplication factor from 1e18 to 1 (remove wei scaling) when computing amount passed to transferFrom.
Change the call to use transferFrom selector with arguments (from, _tos[i], v[i]) but pass v[i] without multiplication and as uint256 literal cast to ensure different calldata.
Make the function return false instead of true at the end, changing the observed return value while keeping execution otherwise identical.
